bathAction.title: Wash thighs
bathAction.tooltip: Wash the thighs, inside and out.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(wash)] [npc.her] thighs, outside first and then the softer skin on the inside, where sweat and anything else has clung. [npc.She] [npc.verb(rinse)] until [npc.her] hands come away clean. [npc.speech(Inside as well. That is the part that sticks.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(slide)] both hands up the inside of [npc.her] thighs, hot water following, and [npc.verb(let)] out a quiet [npc.moan] at how good the heat is there. [npc.She] [npc.verb(take)] [npc.her] time about reaching the top. [npc.speech(Higher. The water feels wonderful on the soft bit.)]
[npc.Name] [npc.verb(scrub)] [npc.her] thighs inside and out and [npc.verb(rinse)] them before the water can feel like anything but work. [npc.speech(Clean. Next.)]
